canonical_example.translation: Hugo suffers from an inferiority complex.

canonical_example.translation: The new municipal government built a sports complex to promote community health.

canonical_example.text: El médico me recomendó tomar un complejo de vitamina B.
canonical_example.translation: The doctor recommended I should take a vitamin B complex.

canonical_example.text: Está complejo el problema, pero sé que lo podemos resolver juntos.

canonical_example.translation: Pili's brother has a lot of insecurities.

canonical_example.translation: The country's most modern medical center will open in January.

canonical_example.translation: The company has built several tourist developments throughout the country.

canonical_example.text: ¿Cuál es el rango de edad de los sujetos bajo estudio?
canonical_example.translation: What is the range of ages of the subjects under study?

canonical_example.translation: In many ancient societies, funerary rites changed according to the social standing of the deceased person.

canonical_example.text: Alberto gana mucho dinero y vive con mucho rango.
canonical_example.translation: Alberto makes a lot of money and lives in great luxury.

canonical_example.translation: My friend Juan is one of my cronies who comes with me everywhere.

canonical_example.translation: Our family's coat of arms features three lions.

canonical_example.text: Sabrina escudó a su hijo cuando lo acusaron de robo.
canonical_example.translation: Sabrina shielded her son when he was accused of theft.

canonical_example.text: Cuando le preguntaron sobre los casos de corrupción, el político se escudó en el típico "yo no sabía nada".
canonical_example.translation: When confronted about the cases of corruption, the politician hid behind the standard "I didn't know."

canonical_example.text: La revista se escudó en el derecho a la libertad de expresión para justificar su tapa controversial.

canonical_example.text: En la fiesta sirvieron canapés y champán.
